notes.title: This game will be changed from charge to free in a week.
notes.notes:
Dear players:
Hello everyone~ Thank you for your continued attention and support.

This game will be changed from paid to free in a week. It has been more than a year since the game was released, but after the production is completed, I have not properly updated and maintained it. I am ashamed. So I hope to make the game free. On the one hand, As a player, you should not spend money to play unmaintained games.On the other hand, I am not satisfied with this game.I feel like I am cheating money.

I am a programmer, but I don’t know anything about art and music, and my English level is also very average. Before making this game, my job was to make AR applications and I had never developed games, but I like playing games very much, no matter what Whether it is a 3A masterpiece or a personal sketch game, I have played a lot. For nearly a year before and after this game, I have been developing games full-time, but only one mobile game and this game can be completed.

I am currently reading a lot of books, history, psychology, biology, novels, etc., of course, they are all types I like. I hope that the next game has a deep theme and rich connotation. At the same time, I am trying to learn art and painting , Although it is a bit difficult to learn and the progress is slow, but at least I am moving forward. I am already at work and the salary is not high, but fortunately I don't have to work overtime.

The review of the price change will be completed in a week, and it shouldn't be too long.

Finally, thank you again. See you in the next game.

notes.title: Escape from the death castle 1.0.9 Update
notes.notes:
The content of this update is as follows:
1.Fixed the issue that the color of the weapon was not displayed correctly when the boss launched the skill.
2. Strength no longer increases health.
3.Increase the maximum health bonus when upgrading.
4. Beautify text prompt UI.
5.Move when hungry, the damage taken is changed to 10% of maximum health.
6.The damage prompt of the three attack buttons no longer shows the percentage but the actual value.
7.Adjust the speed of the attack button animation.
8.Fix non-1920x1080 resolution, which will cause displacement deviation when dragging items.
9.Modify some prompt text.
